title: SEBI Lowers Commodity Derivatives Stress-Testing Z-Score Limit to 5
summary: SEBI lowered Z-score limit for stress testing in commodity derivatives market from 10 to 5 under Core SGF framework.

blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Lowers Commodity Derivatives Stress-Testing Z-Score Limit to 5. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: SEBI lowered Z-score limit for stress testing in commodity derivatives market from 10 to 5 under Core SGF framework.
**Z-Score Threshold:** Lowered from **10 to 5** to ease compliance for market participants under Core Settlement Guarantee Fund (Core SGF).
**Historical Window:** Uses mean and sigma of returns over Margin Period of Risk (MPOR) across **15 years**.
≠ **Threshold Reduction:** Z-score reduced from 10 to 5 (15-year MPOR window).
